title: Photo Plans
seo: Etsy product photo plans and mockups
meta: A shot list and mockup plan that helps your Etsy items look their best, with layouts ready to use. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Etsy photo plans that show your product well
overview: Good photos sell on Etsy, and many shops use only two or three of their ten slots. We plan the full set for your item: the thumbnail, the detail shots, scale and in-use shots, packaging and a final image that answers common questions. You get a shot list with simple lighting and prop tips for your phone camera. In larger packages we also build mockups from your own artwork, ready to upload.

faq: No, we plan them and make mockups from your files. You shoot with a phone, a table and window light, using our shot list. For a few examples, we can mark up your photos to show what to change.
Where do mockup images come from?
From stock scene files we are licensed to use, or from mockup sets you own. We use only images you have the right to use, and we show the source so you can check the licence.
Can you fix my current photos?

We review them and tell you what to retake. Simple edits, like crop, background clean-up or brightness, can be added through the add-ons. We do not alter a product to look different from what you ship.
Yes. Etsy asks for clear images of the real item and wants you to show what the buyer will receive. We follow those rules and flag anything, like heavy text overlays, that could cause a problem.
